rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name and zip, identified the correct orders, and made accurate changes with correct tool usage. However, it performed two order-changing writes without first obtaining explicit confirmation: (1) it updated the shipping address on the pending watch order to the New York address without confirming the exact change, and (2) it modified the silicone watch to a metal white variant without prior confirmation. The agent did properly request confirmation before modifying the air purifier in the pending order. Despite otherwise accurate execution and information, failing to obtain explicit confirmation before the first two writes violates the policy, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
